events.title: Elevators stuck for 6 weeks, riders refuse rescue
events.description: Around 9 AM the Floor 41 elevator banks froze between floors. Maintenance took six hours to clear. By hour two there was a small impromptu salon in the lobby. Rita Cheng had a folding chair.

events.title: Water reaches six floors; Council says further study needed before flood emergency declared
events.description: Standing water appeared on Floors 2, 4, 6, 9, 11 and 34 over a single morning. The League called it unrelated to the pressure anomaly on 38-41.

events.title: Council sets election date, urges every resident to vote
events.description: The Triboro Council fixed a date for the long-delayed election and launched a get-out-the-vote push. Citizen organizations have not said if they will participate.

events.title: Kirwin Foods puts Mood Muffins in every floor drop this week
events.description: Kirwin's announced Mood Muffins would ship in every floor's supply drop through the week. A Seed Club points bonus applies.

events.title: Aurora Report: Green for the eleventh straight day
events.description: The daily Aurora Report held at Green for an eleventh consecutive day. The Aurora Cult gave thanks; meteorologists urged calm.

events.title: League of Trades reports 'minor' pressure anomaly on Floors 38-41
events.description: The League acknowledged a water-pressure anomaly across Floors 38-41, called it minor, and blamed 'possible sabotage.' Residents on those floors report worse.

events.title: Theater District's official troupes demand crackdown on pirated performances
events.description: The sponsored repertory companies signed an open letter calling for action against unlicensed performers reading from novels and newspapers they don't own.

events.title: Aurora Cult announces 'Divine Dice' night to boost attendance
events.description: With attendance flagging, the Aurora Cult announced another Divine Dice night, pitched as a way for wagers to win the Aurora's favor.

events.title: Child on Floor 52 says she saw 'a boy in the Aurora'; parents told not to worry
events.description: A girl on Floor 52 told neighbors she saw a boy's face in the smog outside a sealed window. The Health Committee advised parents it was almost certainly nothing.

events.title: Councilman Gil Duffy vanishes; Council seat empty as Citizen Groups trade blame
events.description: Councilman Duffy failed to appear at the election-prep session and cannot be found. His office on 29 is sealed. The League and Kirwin Foods each accuse the other; the Security Branch says it is 'looking into it.' The building is not staying quiet.

events.title: Clergy exemption schedules turn up in Council records
events.description: Election-prep filing turned up the Aurora Cult's old clergy exemption schedules: platinum membership at Kirwin's, blanket exemption from Public Service, entertainment expensed as sermon research. Every line of it is decades expired. The Council says the review is ongoing.

events.title: Newsletter profiles the building's last midnight observance, attendance one
events.description: The Community Newsletter ran a filler item on the midnight observance still held weekly on 47, noting attendance has been one person for some time. The piece calls her Triboro's loneliest devotee.

events.title: Council approves transfer of the Floor 12 schoolhouse to Kirwin Foods
events.description: The old Aurora school on 12, the last of the church's schools still under its name, goes to Kirwin Foods, which will reopen it as a Seed Club learning annex.

events.title: Mask warning in effect East side; compliance called 'spotty'
events.description: An Aurora advisory covering the East ran through the morning. Security put the compliance rate at 'spotty' and declined to define it. Several residents were photographed unmasked and appear pleased about it.

events.title: Betting accounts locked for a third week; operator cites a filing issue
events.description: Access to the books has been down for going on three weeks. The operator continues to describe it as a filing issue. No filings have been produced. Wagering has moved to hallways, stairwells, and the area outside the market.

events.title: Chorus goes on two voices short; management calls it 'a texture choice'
events.description: Two members of the evening chorus did not appear. The company performed anyway. A spokesman for the Theater District described the resulting sound as 'a texture choice.' Ticket holders were not offered anything.

events.title: Winter sun schedule posted; West window sessions capped at four minutes
events.description: The seasonal window schedule is up. Sessions on the West side are capped at four minutes a floor and the line is managed by floorship. Signs asking residents not to press their hands on the glass have been reissued, as they are every year, to no effect.

events.title: Chamber of commerce disbands after third robbery; carpet fund gone with it
events.description: The West-side chamber of commerce has dissolved following a third robbery of its accounts. The money had been raised to replace the hallway carpet, which is worn through to the beige floor near every elevator bank. Replacement would have required agreement from every floorship regardless.

events.title: Bread Basket tours remain suspended; Kirwin's cites 'the state of the world'
events.description: Kirwin Foods confirmed the public tours of the Bread Basket will not resume this year, citing the state of the world. School field trips ended some time ago. The Basket continues to feed the building.

events.title: Blind Fish of unusual size pulled from the hatchery streams
events.description: Pickers in the Bread Basket report several Blind Fish well past two feet coming out of the covered streams this season. Kirwin Foods says growth is within expected range. TB Alerts has opened a line on the largest fish of the year.

events.title: Consolidation Commission begins serving dissolution notices to floorships
events.description: The Government Consolidation Commission has begun serving notices on floorship-level governments, which it recommends dissolving. The Commission's finding is that floorships consistently fail to field enough candidates for procedural work, and that business has stalled building-wide as a result. Notices are being served in person.

events.title: Second Story floorship office found staffed by one man
events.description: An officer serving dissolution notices on the Second Story found the floorship office occupied by a single official, who thanked her for her time. He appeared to have slept in the office. He did not contest the notice.

events.title: Residents on 26 report movement above the drop ceilings
events.description: Several households on Floor 26 have reported noise from above the ceiling tiles, described variously as scraping, weight shifting, and 'somebody being careful.' The League says the HVAC runs loud on that floor. Security has advised residents not to investigate personally.

events.title: Babbage Press revisits the vacant unit left open since the spring riot
events.description: The unit vacated during the spring riot remains open and unsecured. The family left in the middle of the night and has not returned. Municipal inspectors visit occasionally; so do others. The Press first called it a symbol of blight some years ago and has now called it that again.

events.title: Kirwin's Komunity center opens on Floor 31, a League floor
events.description: A new Kirwin's Komunity center has opened on 31. The centers can be sited where the zoning does not permit food storage, which tends to place them close to the League. The new posting is a dentist offering free checkups and snack taste-tests. He has been distributing hand-drawn cards.

events.title: Sand Cakes taste-test draws a line; feedback cards collected by hand
events.description: The new Kirwin's snack is being trialled at Komunity centers ahead of a floor-drop rollout. Residents are asked to fill out a card. The cards are collected by hand and sent to headquarters. Reception has been mixed and attendance has been high.

events.title: Council urges parents to know what their children are calling themselves
events.description: A Council advisory has asked parents to take an interest in what their children's groups are named and what those groups believe they are for. The advisory does not use the word militia. Every response to it does.

events.title: Man seen waiting on East 2nd near the market holding a silver yoyo
events.description: Several residents have reported a man standing near the market on East 2nd for most of a morning, holding a silver yoyo and not using it. He spoke to at least one person. Nobody has said what about. Kirwin's Komunity centers are widely assumed to run the building's private detectives, though the assumption has never been demonstrated.

posts.text: Elevators on 41 stuck. Six hours. What happens when you put Off-the-Shelf parts in for Critical Infrastructure. A Building needs constant care, not just talk. Don't know why anyone would be up there anyway.
dale says someone keeps stealing the LAUNDRY ROOM ASHTRAY. for the record this is the third one this month
hallway lights on floor 31 flickering in morse again. nobody answering.
floor 12 vending machine swallowed three tokens and a hairpin. xoxo
Friends, the past is a foreign aisle. We look forward, and Thursday we look forward TOGETHER at Divine Dice, with all proceeds to our new Transparency Fund, which we are founding Thursday.

My uncle was a perks man. Platinum at Kirwin's, no Public Service, wrote off every night out as sermon research. He also taught half of Floor 30 to read. Both of those are on the same page of the same ledger.
I have never been exempt from anything.
Forty years of no Public Service. My father did eleven rotations in the vents and got a certificate that spelled his name wrong.
Kirwin Foods has always honored its community partnerships. Membership tiers are a matter of record. The record is in a box.
The Records Office is doing important work. The documents are under review. The review is ongoing. This has been an update.

my mother used to say you could always spot a deacon because he never once waited for anything

I should go. I mean to go. It's at midnight.

putting twenty credits on two people showing up next week. i will be one of them. this is not a bet, it's a business plan

My uncle taught phonics, mathematics and track in that building. He did it for nothing because he was a deacon, and he got platinum at Kirwin's for it. Now Kirwin's has the building. There's a joke in there and I don't want to find it.
Kirwin Foods is proud to steward the Floor 12 annex. Curriculum will emphasize nutrition, loyalty, and the free market. Seed Club points available from age four.
I learned long division in that room from a man in a robe who smelled like cigarettes. Best teacher I ever had. They're putting a points scanner in it.
I did not know it was still ours until it wasn't.
The League notes that this transfer cleared in nine days. Water main repairs on thirty through forty-five have been pending four years. We are simply noting it.
wait the church had SCHOOLS?? like real ones with desks??

Beloved, we did not lose a school. We unlocked liquidity.
A mask warning is not a suggestion. It is a warning. That is why it is called a warning. Also the new coaster line is up.
Went out without it. Some days you want the building to see your face.
He went out without his mask. He is very handsome and very stupid and I have said my piece.
dale never wears his either. i've stopped bringing it up because i like the peace
Compliance was spotty. I was compliant. I want that noted somewhere permanent.

my whole floor unmasked at once like a talent show
The Aurora does not require your face. But it does notice.
Still locked out. Three weeks. A man needs somewhere to put a feeling.
the 'filing issue' is that they filed the money somewhere else
The BETTING is DOWN and the theater has never been more ALIVE. People are wagering on the SHOW again. On MY show. I have never felt so seen!!!
took a bet in a stairwell like our grandfathers did. beautiful. lost everything.
Three weeks of downtime on any system the League ran would be a scandal. This one's a filing issue.
This is exactly what the League warned about. I have only been in the League six weeks but I warned about it.
Kirwin's Savings & Loan reminds members that pre-payday products remain fully available during the outage.
he checks it every hour. it is the same every hour. i love him.
TWO VOICES SHORT and we went ON anyway! The sound was HAUNTED! People wept! Some of them were weeping about the sound QUALITY but they WEPT!!!
I should have called Paul. I know I should have called Paul.
paul is going to be pissed and paul is right to be pissed

standards would have carried it. the modern stuff needs everybody.
In DUTCH MELTON AND THE SILENT ROW, a man misses his shift and it costs the building everything. I wrote that in Year 68. Nobody listened then either.
half the chorus can't read the modern arrangements and management knows it
brought the rags. brought the wipes. we clean up after ourselves over there, that's the arrangement, it's the one thing we do right
four minutes. i waited two hours. worth it. warm glass on a cold cheek, there's nothing
People who stay late when there's no line should be working. I'm not saying it's a crime. I'm saying we all know who they are.
People make room for us at the window. I've never asked why and I don't intend to start.
my mother couldn't come over here at all when the bridge was closed. she says the winters were worse. she says it flat, like reading a label.
the signs say don't press your hands on the glass. everyone presses their hands on the glass. the signs are load-bearing at this point
Four minutes of sun a year, and we queue for it, and we thank them. I'm not being bitter. I go too.
stood there til it went cold. nobody left to feel sorry for me so i felt sorry for myself, which is more efficient
Third robbery. THIRD. At some point it stops being a robbery and starts being a business model.
The carpet has been like that since I was a girl. Red and mustard stripes. Shiny down the middle. I would genuinely miss it.
You could smell that carpet. I don't mean that badly. I sell scent for a living and I'm telling you it had one.
Every floorship would have had to agree. Every one. That was never happening and the robbery just saved us the meeting.
This is precisely the coordination failure the Commission was constituted to address. I take no satisfaction in it.
THIRD TIME UNLUCKY: The Chamber, The Carpet, And The Money That Keeps Leaving. A Babbage Family Press retrospective.
we all point at the carpet when we say what's wrong with this place. now we'll point at it forever

I went down there on a field trip as a boy and it made me a food science student. You stand at the top of the stairs and it's just the red lamps for acres. Suspended in midair. It's a damn shame nobody sees it now.
The Bread Basket is a working agricultural facility, not an attraction. Kirwin Foods thanks the community for its understanding.
Worked a summer down there for extra money. Everybody did. The red light gets in your eyes for a week after.
it's the fish that get you. you're three quarters down the stairs and the light catches one and you jump. every time. everyone says this. it's a cliche and it's still true.
Glow necklaces for the bosses. Painted vests for the rest of us. From the top of the stairs you look like garbage bags moving in the rows.
Tours stopped, kids still work it after school. Draw your own conclusions about which one was the safety concern.
My father put the lamps in himself. Red, because green things want red. That is the whole of it and there is nothing else to say.
hard to eat a blind fish once you've seen one. i manage.
Two feet is normal. This was not two feet. I have been down there eleven years.
Growth is within expected range. Kirwin's Blind Fish remains the delicacy of the Triboro and is now available in a family portion.
Nothing grows past what it's fed. Just a gardening thought. No reason.
A TWO FOOT FISH WITH NO EYES came out of the DARK WATER and I have been told I cannot put it in the show. I am APPEALING.
I taste-tested it. Didn't sleep. Works!
People are frightened of the fish because it has no eyes and lives in the dark. So does everything down there. So do we.
ask what else is in those streams. i'll wait.
In theory I leave the notice and go. I stay for questions. That is not required of me. I stay for questions in the name of democracy.
Every notice will be served in person, by hand, with time allowed for questions. If this is the end of a thing it will be a properly minuted end.
We didn't fail to field candidates. Nobody wanted the job. Those are different and the difference is the whole story.
Dissolve them then. My floorship hasn't had a quorum since my daughter was small and she has a daughter.

The League notes that when the small governments go, the only bodies left standing will be the two that can afford to stand. Draw the picture yourself.
i have been on my floorship council for nine years. i have never once been elected. i just kept showing up.
THE LAST OF THE SMALL GOVERNMENTS: What Dissolution Would Actually Change. Part one of a series by Ward Babbage.
Filing deadline passed with two candidates for eleven seats. I'm one of the two and I don't want it.
I prepared for an argument. I have prepared for an argument my whole life. He thanked me and his voice cracked.
He's been running that office alone for two years. Everyone knows. Nobody relieved him.
That man kept a government open by himself. Whatever the Commission decides, that should be in the record.
slept in the office. dress pants, undershirt. i've seen him at the water point at odd hours so it tracks
Oh, the poor man. Somebody bring him something. I'm not being dramatic, somebody actually bring him something.
Forty-five years of midnight observances, attendance one. I know exactly what that office looks like from the inside.
this is the saddest thing i have read on this app and i once read a live account of the dog situation
It's the HVAC. On that floor it runs loud enough to cover anything. That's not reassurance, that's the point I'm making.
The tiles up there sit on thin metal dividers. If you keep three holds before you move anything, they take your weight. Not that I'd know now.
Do not go up there. Do not send a child up there. I will not be explaining how I know.
Residents should not investigate ceiling voids personally. Report it. Also, birdhouses.
Everything above your ceiling belongs to the building and the building belongs to the League. Somebody's up there who shouldn't be.
above the ceiling on 26, below the floor on 61. i've said what i've said

they left in the middle of the night and nobody has said their name since. that's the part that gets me

tastes like a coaster that believes in itself
